multiforge_debug.configuration.title: MultiForge Debug
multiforge_debug.configuration.hud.toolt: Top-left block: server build, region count, worst region MSPT.
multiforge_debug.configuration.regionLis: Top-left per-region detail rows, under the summary block.
multiforge_debug.configuration.violation: Right-hand panel of live reroute/ownership warnings.
multiforge_debug.configuration.chunkBord: In-world seams where two adjacent chunks belong to different regions.
multiforge_debug.configuration.heatmap.t: Translucent per-chunk tick-cost tint on the ground.
multiforge_debug.configuration.pins.tool: Wireframe boxes around operator-created region pins.
multiforge_debug.configuration.regionLis: Maximum region rows to draw before truncating.
multiforge_debug.configuration.violation: Maximum violation rows to draw. The client retains 200 regardless.
multiforge_debug.configuration.borderRad: Chunks in each direction from the player to test for region seams.
multiforge_debug.configuration.yBelow.to: Blocks below the player that seams and pin boxes extend.
multiforge_debug.configuration.yAbove.to: Blocks above the player that seams and pin boxes extend.
